title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load data

```{r}
df_loss <- 
  read_rds("data_out/df_fu_analysis.rds") %>% 
  filter(age_loss <= 20.5)
```

Fit model

```{r}
fit_after_25 <-
    survival::coxph(survival::Surv(fu_start, fu_anypsy_after_25_all, event = is_anypsy_after_25_all)
                    ~age_loss_cat + survival::strata(fam_link),
                    data = df_loss %>% filter(!preexist_diag))
```

Extract coeffiecients

```{r}
df_coeffs_after_25 <- 
  parameters::parameters(fit_after_25, exp = T) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(age_cat = str_extract(Parameter, "(?<=age_loss_cat)\\d+"),
         age_cat = as.numeric(age_cat)) %>%
  filter(age_cat != 0)
```

Plot

```{r}
df_coeffs_after_25 %>% 
  
  ggplot(aes(x = age_cat, 
             y = Coefficient,
             ymin = CI_low,
             ymax = CI_high)) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 1/4, color = "gray", fill =NA, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red2", linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 18, alpha = .3, linewidth = 20) +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 1.6, label = "Reference age group",
           angle = 270, size = 4) +
  # facet_wrap(~outc, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 18, by = 2),
                     labels = c(seq(0, 16, by = 2), "18-20"),
                     limits = c(0, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age at parental loss", y = "Hazard ratio") +
  theme_minimal()
```
